metadata.title: Urban Stencil Portrait with Sunburst Background

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, three-tone stencil portrait of a bearded man set against a vibrant orange and tan sunburst background, heavily layered with urban textures, ink splatters, and distressed paper effects.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black stencil against warm sunburst rays
Rough, distressed textures overlaying clean geometric sunburst lines
Asymmetrical portrait placement balanced by top-left typography block
Vertical numeric elements on the right balancing the horizontal text on the left
coreInvariants: Stencil-style facial features with solid black shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait positioned slightly right of center, cropped at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast black beard and eyes of the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text block, follows the sunburst rays toward the subject's face, and ends at the vertical numbers on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is densely packed with rays, splatters, and textures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange rays contrasted with desaturated, neutral cream and deep black.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to orange, cream, black, and white

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly distressed to match the background texture

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a dark, jagged shape
Anchored to the display text block

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed bold sans-serif paired with a wider, spaced-out slab-serif for contrast in rhythm.
graphicDevices: Jagged black background shape for text
Vertical numeric string on the right margin

preserve: Condensed nature of the primary text
Wide tracking of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of the display text.
Provides the blocky, slab-serif contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a stencil-style portrait of a man with a beard in black and cream. Place it on a background of orange and tan sunburst rays. Add heavy textures including paper folds, ink splatters, and grunge distressing. Leave a jagged black space in the top-left corner for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the main title in a white, extra-bold condensed sans-serif font in the top-left black area. Below it, add a subtitle in a white slab-serif font with wide letter spacing. Add a vertical string of numbers in black on the far right edge.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait high-contrast stencil style?
Are the sunburst rays visible but distressed?
Is the text block in the top-left clearly legible against its dark background?
Does the image look like a weathered street poster?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the paper fold textures look integrated and not like a filter.
Check that the stencil shadows define the face clearly.
Verify the orange rays don't overpower the portrait.
Confirm the typography maintains a 'heavy' visual weight.
recipe.reuseFormula: Stencil Portrait + Sunburst Rays + Urban Grunge Textures + Condensed Bold Typography
